rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for acting or appearing sadly and desolately.

example.english: They stood forlornly by the seaside waiting for the boat, looking pitiful.
example.traditional: 佢淒涼咁企喺海邊等船，睇落好可憐。
example.jyutping: keoi5 cai1 loeng4 gam3 kei5 hai2 hoi2 bin1 dang2 syun4 tai2 lok6 hou2 ho2 lin4

rows.note: Use this when the forlorn manner mainly shows emotional dejection or disappointment.

example.english: They sat forlornly after hearing the result and did not even want their favourite egg tart.
example.traditional: 佢失落咁坐喺度，連最鍾意食嘅蛋撻都唔想食。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sat1 lok6 gam3 co5 hai2 dou6 lin4 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 ge3 daan6 taat1 dou1 m4 soeng2 sik6

rows.note: Use this when the forlorn manner emphasizes being visibly alone or abandoned.

example.english: They sat forlornly all alone on a park bench, waiting for someone who never came.
example.traditional: 佢孤零零咁坐喺公園張長櫈上，等緊一個永遠冇出現嘅人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gu1 ling1 ling1 gam3 zo6 hai2 gung1 jyun2 zoeng1 coeng4 dang3 soeng6 dang2 gan2 jat1 go3 wing5 jyun5 mou5 ceot1 jin6 ge3 jan4
